entry.title: New: RES23-308 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
RECOGNIZING THAT THE COUNTIES OF HAWAIʻI HAVE AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN INVASIVE SPECIES CONTROL EFFORTS AND URGING THE CITY ADMINISTRATION TO COLLABORATIVELY ADVANCE THOSE EFFORTS IN THE CITY AND COUNTY OF HONOLULU.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution were adopted.
